answer: Identity bonds decay like shale: each identity posts a 40-unit bond losing 2 units each epoch unless attested. Sybils must keep wandering between fresh identities as old bonds rot to zero. 100 fakes cost 4,000 up front plus 200 decay per epoch against about 30 reward, so the farm bleeds out. An honest agent posts once and earns enough to cover its decay; a prism of uptime, attestations and disputes sets decay speed, so clean agents last longest.
